title: Shadow Copies Deleted Before Encryption
content: Endpoint telemetry shows vssadmin deleting shadow copies and wbadmin deleting backup catalog shortly before many files are renamed with a ransom extension.

expected.threat_summary: Shadow copies and backup artifacts are deleted before file encryption activity.
key_behaviors: file encryption or ransom extension follows
hunt_checklist: Review process telemetry for vssadmin/wmic/wbadmin/bcdedit recovery disruption commands.
Check file events for mass rename/encryption after recovery inhibition.
Identify user, host, parent process, command line, and affected shares.
expected.correlation_logic: Correlate recovery disruption commands, process chain, file encryption events, user, host, and time window.
expected.escalation_condition: Escalate immediately when shadow copy or backup deletion is followed by encryption activity.
expected.analyst_notes: Hand-authored external gold standard case for accuracy/generalization evaluation.
